scoreUnit: independently verified planted bugs fixed out of 105
methodology: Same task prompt and two repositories; each model runs through its native agentic CLI. Blind grading uses the model's code diff as ground truth. Only planted bugs fixed and verified count. Unplanted discoveries are reported separately.
matchingPolicy: Use the benchmark owner's exact evaluated model identity and current route. Use the owner's published mean when repeated runs exist; otherwise retain the single official result with sample size 1. Do not transfer across model versions or variants, and do not use mixed-route runs when a single-route official result exists.

Codex 0.155.1 is newer than the 0.154.0 build of the older OpenAI rows, which refuses this model; the GPT-6 Luna rungs compare cleanly with each other. The machine was idle for both legs. Cost is a list-rate floor at OpenAI's short-context rates (the long-context surcharge is not modelled), not a bill. Owner decision O51 (2026-10-23): every configuration AA plots on its rendered frontier or within 3 Index points of it is its own row; no result is transferred between efforts.

models.note: Benchmark-owner scoreboard mean of three Opus 5.5 high-effort runs through Claude Code on the first-party API (32, 32 and 31 of 105; repo 1 14, 13, 12 of 45, repo 2 18, 19, 19 of 60; spread 1), superseding the owner's single run and mean of two at the same effort. Model string claude-opus-5-5[1m] (1M window, zero compactions); runs sequential, walls contended by other vendors' legs. Cost is a list-rate estimate at Anthropic's published Opus 5.5 rates, not an invoice. Owner decision O51 (2026-10-23): every configuration AA plots on its rendered frontier or within 3 Index points of it is its own row; no result is transferred between efforts.
